notes: One catalogue page = one product with its own image (images/products/pNNN.jpg).
Colours were read from the colour thumbnails on each catalogue page.

Sizes are not printed in the catalogue for most styles: defaults are bras 30-40, C-cup 34-42, panties 80-90 / 95-100, camisoles/shapewear S-XXL. Edit here before importing or later in Admin > Products.
Catalogue style numbers used by two products get the product name appended to keep SKUs unique (e.g. 1010-AAKRITI-SET).
Products with "size_mrp" have a different MRP per size; "mrp" is the lowest.
